response.text:
The client's request is in English, but the site and the earlier replies are in Slovene. The rules say the reply should be in the client's language, so I answer in English and write the site copy in Slovene.

The client gave the shipping facts (delivery across Slovenia, free over 75 €), so they count as provided. I add an announcement section on the homepage, right after the contact strip, so it is visible near the top on mobile. Its ids are new and unique.

The gift section (s_gift) says "Naročite po telefonu ali e-pošti, prevzamete v trgovini", and the highlights say "Prevzem v trgovini". These now describe only pickup, but the request is to mention shipping, so I leave them unchanged. Adding the announcement is the minimal change.

Announcement copy:
- Title: "Darilne pakete pošiljamo po Sloveniji" (37 characters, under the 60 limit).
- Text: "Pri naročilu nad 75 € je poštnina brezplačna." (under the 200 limit).
- Link: "Več o darilih", pointing to page p_darila.

I insert it at index 2 of the home sections, after s_strip.
